data.name: GraeHart
data.detailed_description:
Inspired by Breath of Fire, GraeHart is a 16-bit inspired medieval fantasy RPG blending brutal turn-based combat with Zelda-inspired exploration.

You play as Percival Winfred, a young hunter whose coming-of-age gift—an ancestral sword—awakens visions of a fallen hero and a prophecy buried in blood. What begins as unrest within his village soon reveals something far older stirring beneath the kingdom: a curse bound to the Winfred lineage and born from a Fallen Angel’s betrayal.

The blade Percival inherits is more than steel—it is a relic tied to an unfinished war between realms. The Winfred bloodline was marked generations ago, bound to seal, confront, or unleash a power that was never meant to return. As shadows rise, smugglers move beneath the streets, and villages begin to fracture, Percival must decide what it truly means to carry his family’s legacy.

At the center of his world is Clara—his sister, an archer who is fiercely loyal and quietly unbreakable. As the threat deepens, Clara becomes entwined in the growing conflict, forcing Percival to confront the cost of destiny. Some battles are fought with swords. Others are fought with sacrifice.

Features include:

🏹 Story Campaign – Experience the complete first ACT, featuring all 6 chapters with refined cutscenes, improved dialogue, smoother pacing, and an updated Quest Journal that keeps your main objectives clear.

🔥 Bonfire System – Bonfires serve as the heart of your adventure. Heal your party, level up, save your game, and Fast Travel at dedicated rest hubs throughout the world.

⚔️ Gameplay Systems – Build Percival or your character your way with an evolving skill tree, combat improvements, balance updates, and expanded character progression.

📜 Side Quests (Coming Soon) – Take on optional quests throughout the world to earn unique rewards, uncover additional lore, and help the people of Graehart beyond the main story.

🎮 Free Play Mode – Once you've experienced the story, jump into Free Play Mode to continue exploring the world, complete optional content, challenge tougher enemies, and discover anything you may have missed.

🤝 Multiplayer Co-op (Coming December) – Team up with friends in an upcoming online co-op mode, allowing you to tackle adventures, explore the world, and battle enemies together.

💬 Partially Voiced Characters – Important story moments and conversations feature voice acting, with additional voice-over being added throughout development.

Uncover the mysteries surrounding a fallen hero, an ancient curse, and the legacy of the Winfred family as you journey through lively villages, dangerous dungeons, and hidden paths filled with secrets waiting to be discovered.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7/8/8.1/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or i7 (8th Gen or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 or 7
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 560 and above
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
